output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial supply is set in the constructor, and mintedAmount is added to balanceOf[target] without a check, allowing the owner to mint arbitrary large tokens.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function decreases balanceOf[_from] by _value, but does not check if balanceOf[_from] is large enough, allowing users to buy tokens at a reduced price.
The transfer function calls _transfer, which has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing users to buy tokens at a reduced price.
The transferFrom function calls _transfer, which has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing users to buy tokens at a reduced price.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the new allowance overflows uint256, allowing users to approve a large allowance.
